subject.title: Feature Request: Add .gitignore-like exclude patterns to backup CLI

question: Should OpenClaw add native backup exclude-pattern controls now, and which defaults and protected recovery paths should become part of the core CLI contract?
rationale: The missing capability is clear from source, but defaults and protected paths decide the security/recoverability tradeoff and an open PR already proposes new CLI/API behavior.

options.title: Review linked PR as canonical
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/44288 to settle defaults, protected paths, manifest/JSON compatibility, and proof before landing or narrowing it.

options.title: Narrow to custom excludes first
options.body: Accept only explicit `--exclude` and `--exclude-file` behavior first, while deferring smart defaults until restore completeness and security expectations are settled.

options.title: Defer native excludes
options.body: Keep core backups coarse for now and document current scope while optional backup strategies remain outside core.

recommendation.title: Review linked PR as canonical
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/44288 to settle defaults, protected paths, manifest/JSON compatibility, and proof before landing or narrowing it.

likelyOwner.reason: Their history spans review of the original backup CLI and extraction of the current backup infra boundary, making them the best available owner for the product/security contract choice.
